incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU pool eu-west-1 saturated. autoscaler attempted 6 scaleups in last 3m, all failed. Queue growth + throttling observed. Root ts=5690123456.

Maya (SRE): seeing 95% queue utilization on gpu-pool-eu-west. latency p95 for gen API ~12s and error rate 6% (429/503).

Jules (Platform): autoscaler logs show repeated: \"scaleup failed: provider error quotaExceeded: requested 4, available 0\". Provider returned 409 on capacity reservation.

Ravi (ML-Infra): some models hitting long KV-cache warmups that drive slots. Can we evict low-priority tenants and free nodes?

Ava (Oncall): currently routing policy to fallback region is ON but weight is 0.5, requests still prefer eu-west. I'll flip to 0.2 to push more to eu-central. Doing now.

Eden (CS): two enterprise customers reported latency spikes and 10–20% failed requests in the last 30m. CS has opened tickets and notified SLAs.

Maya (SRE): mitigation checklist: 1) lower non-prod priority popover 2) enable emergency reserved pool (if auth) 3) manual node launch attempt 4) throttle low-priority tenants at ingress.

Jules (Platform): manual node launch attempted via infra tool: ``launch-pool --region eu-west-1 --count 2 --instance-type p4d``. Provider API returns 403/insufficient quota for p4d. Trying alternative instance type p3dn.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: auto-scaling disabled for pool gpu-pool-eu-west until further notice (temporary stop to avoid noisy re-attempts).

Ravi (ML-Infra): temp workaround: enable model-quantization fallback on heavy models to reduce slot usage (patching config). Pushing config now: ``model.configs.quantize: true``.

Ava (Oncall): started traffic steering change at 5690123480. Observed ~18% drop in queue within 90s. Not full recovery yet.

Maya (SRE): applied ingress throttling rule to drop/queue requests from non-reserved tenants above 80% usage. Rule ID: throttles/ew1-5690.

CloudSupportBot: Support ticket opened with provider (TICKET-987654). Provider initial reply: \"we see quota spike, requesting quota increase approval. Typical turnaround 2–6 hours\".

Eden (CS): impacted customers list: AcmeCorp (high), BrightApps (medium). AcmeCorp saw 18% 5xx over 20m. We sent interim note.

Jules (Platform): action taken summary: traffic steering, ingress throttles, quantization fallbacks, temporary autoscaler disable, manual scale attempts (failed due to quota).

Maya (SRE): current metrics at 5690123560: queue 62% -> down from 95%, p95 latency 4.6s, error rate 1.2%. Still monitoring.

Ava (Oncall): handing off to night oncall at 5690123600. Night oncall: @Eve-night please acknowledge — mitigation in place, provider ticket pending, CS alerted.

Ravi (ML-Infra): please log immediate postmortem notes: timeline, root cause (provider quota + autoscaler retry storm), mitigations and long-term actions. I'll add quantization toggle as a permanent option for burst scenarios.

Maya (SRE): preliminary action items: 
- Reach out to provider to expedite quota increase (owner: Jules)
- Add reserve capacity for critical tenants (owner: Product/Sales lead)
- Fail-open routing policy improvement: make weight adjustments automated based on queue over threshold (owner: Platform)
- Autoscaler backoff tuning to avoid tight retry loops (owner: SRE)
- Oncall runbook update to include explicit ingress throttling commands and model-fallback steps (owner: SRE/Ravi)

Eden (CS): will coordinate customer impact summary and follow-ups.

Jules (Platform): filing CL to change autoscaler to exponential backoff and to prevent repeated provider quota hits. Will target patch in 48h.

Ava (Oncall): night oncall acknowledged. Leaving thread open for follow-ups and a formal postmortem.

Maya (SRE): closing notes for now — system stabilized enough to stop active pager. Keep monitoring dashboards and resume normal autoscaler after provider confirms quota or alternative capacity validated.

-- end thread --
